decisions.reason: As a consumer product far from the firm's core waste-to-value options and with only a brief website mention, its option value appears low relative to the cost of maintaining a consumer brand.
As a modular product line with several models close to the established offer, it retains valuable upside uncertainty and manageable keeping costs.
As a flagship with its own page and a waste-oil-to-energy plant, it has received more commitment and still holds important option value under uncertainty.
Close to the established offer and presented as a flagship, its plastic-waste-to-fuel option remains promising enough to keep while uncertainty resolves.
